action.instructions: Choose the best single hero input in this three-lane MOBA.

criteria.advance: Move one cell toward the enemy tower/core when supported by allied minions.
criteria.retreat: Move one cell toward home to leave danger.
criteria.attack: Clear one nearby enemy minion, or damage an exposed tower/core in range.
criteria.skill: Clear three nearby minions or damage an exposed tower/core when cooldown is zero.
criteria.lane_left: Rotate one lane toward top to help a threatened lane or find a push.
criteria.lane_right: Rotate one lane toward bot to help a threatened lane or find a push.
criteria.wait: Hold position while minions advance or a cooldown expires.

danger.instructions: If the hero waits, how soon does the hero lose HP or lose the game?
criteria: Safe for the next two beats.

incoming_attack.instructions: Will waiting one beat cause the hero to lose HP or lose the game?
